purpose: Teach: 検挙/記帳/投書/動議/募っ/危惧し/横ばい/雑多

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の不祥事、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、検挙、絶対、報道、絶対、続いていますね
lines.en: We're seeing a steady stream of industry scandals — arrests, media coverage — it just keeps going, doesn't it.
lines.style: Measured, slightly weary opening. Acknowledging a pattern without dramatizing it. Gentle question at the end, inviting agreement rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、記帳、絶対、サービス、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling customer records and service with real care — I'm grateful we can say that.
lines.style: Professional but warm. Each phrase lands with quiet confidence. A note of genuine relief that the company is doing this right.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内報への、本気で、絶対、投書、絶対、増えてきていますね
lines.en: And we're getting more letters in the internal newsletter about it all.
lines.style: Observational, slightly troubled. A pause implied before speaking, like noticing something that matters. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次回の、本気で、絶対、動議、絶対、案件、絶対、検討、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively reviewing proposals for our next steps — we want to stay ahead of what's coming.
lines.style: Forward-looking and deliberate. Confidence without cockiness. Each commitment lands clearly. Gratitude for being part of the solution.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: インターンを、本気で、絶対、募って、絶対、まいりましょう
lines.en: Let's put out new initiatives. We should bring in interns to help us think differently.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Clear vision with inclusive language — 'let's' not 'you will.' A note of optimism beneath the strategy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、業界の規制強化、絶対、危惧して、絶対、対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company is genuinely concerned about stronger industry regulation coming, so we're working on countermeasures now.
lines.style: Serious, forward-thinking. No false cheerfulness — this is real preparation. Ends with quiet satisfaction that they're moving now, not later.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市場が、本気で、絶対、横ばい、絶対、なので、絶対、新機軸を、絶対、打ち出しましょう
lines.en: The market's flat, so we need to introduce something genuinely new to stand out.
lines.style: Direct assessment, then pivots to possibility. No hand-wringing — clear-eyed about the problem and ready to solve it. Energetic close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。雑多、本気で、絶対、な書類、絶対、デジタル化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're digitizing all our scattered paperwork — that's one concrete step forward, and I'm grateful we're making progress.
lines.style: Grounded, finishing strong. Each task is real and visible. Quiet sense of accomplishment without overselling it. The close of a productive conversation.
